blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait. To achieve both 3D controllability and complex facial light transport, we factorize avatar synthesis into an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy and a causal autoregressive neural shader. This proxy disentangles canonical geometry and reflectance attributes, rapidly rasterizing deformed Gaussians into view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers. Conditioned on these buffers, our neural shader formulates forward rendering as a conditional video diffusion process, bypassing explicit PBR computation to synthesize realistic shading effects under target illumination. We achieve real-time streaming through heterogeneous distillation from a pretrained multi-step bidirectional relighting teacher to a two-step causal autoregressive neural shader, inheriting broad synthetic lighting priors while minimizing conditioning and decoding latency. To further specialize these priors to human heads, we construct a hybrid relighting dataset for domain-specific fine-tuning, capturing authentic facial dynamics and physically grounded light transport. Extensive experiments show that our framework enables 3D-controllable, real-time portrait animation and relighting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity, motion control, and lighting accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LuxAvatar,这是实时头像动画和从一幅肖像中重新点亮的信号前导框架。 为了实现3D可控性和复杂的面相光传输,我们将可视化的活性合成作为可视化的3D内在高斯亚代用物和因果自相递入神经阴道. 这种代理脱落了犬形几何和反射属性,将已变形的高斯人迅速光栅化为景色和运动相容的PBR缓冲. 以这些缓冲器为条件,我们的神经阴影器将前向渲染作为有条件的视频传播过程,绕过明确的PBR计算,以合成目标照明下的现实的阴影效果. 我们通过不同分泌实现实时流线,从预先训练的多步双向复电老师到双步因果自旋神经遮蔽器,继承了广泛的合成照明前科,同时将调节和解码后期. 为了进一步专门化这些人类头部的前科,我们构建了一个混合重燃数据集,用于特定域的微调,捕捉真实的面部动态和物理上被禁入的光传输. 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架能够实现3D控制,实时的肖像动画和再光,在视觉忠贞,运动控制和照明精度方面表现优于最先进的方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Creating animatable and relightable head avatars is crucial for telepresence, immersive communication, and digital content creation.
Seamless integration into virtual environments demands not only faithful facial motion, but also photorealistic appearance that adapts naturally to novel illumination.
However, convincing head relighting is inherently difficult, as it requires modeling the intricate light transport among dynamic facial geometry, complex skin reflectance, and environmental lighting.
Without costly acquisition setups or heavy rendering overhead, capturing and representing these complex effects with high visual fidelity remains a fundamental challenge.
blocks.zh:
创建可想象和可再现的头像对远程存在、浸润性通信和数字内容的创造至关重要。
无缝融合到虚拟环境中不仅需要忠实的面部运动,还需要光现实主义的外观,这种外观自然适应新颖的照明.
然而,令人信服的头部重燃本身就很困难,因为它需要在动态面部几何、复杂的皮肤反射和环境照明之间模拟复杂的光传输。
没有昂贵的购置装置或沉重的俯冲性,捕捉这些复杂效应并表现出高度的视觉忠诚,仍然是一个根本性的挑战。

blocks.en:
Traditional approaches [ 10 , 45 , 20 ] to relightable head modeling either reconstruct facial meshes and reflectance maps for physically based rendering or linearly combine images captured under basis lighting.
However, they often struggle with complex structures such as hair and detailed appearance.
Subsequent neural volumetric head models [ 83 , 62 , 29 , 78 , 49 , 58 , 59 ] capture fine geometry and lighting effects via learned volumetric fields, at the cost of slow ray marching.
Recently, relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods [ 61 , 37 , 63 , 44 , 80 ] have accelerated rendering by rasterizing explicit Gaussian primitives augmented with material properties or learned light transport.
Despite these rendering advances, reconstructing a new subject still requires time-consuming per-subject optimization and faces a fundamental trade-off in data acquisition.
Light stages provide controlled illumination but entail prohibitive hardware costs, whereas monocular approaches [ 72 , 1 , 88 , 79 ] operate under unknown lighting via ill-posed inverse rendering, often suffering from baked-in shading residuals and simplified analytical shaders that struggle to model realistic light transport.
blocks.zh:
传统方法[10,45,20],可以重燃头部模型,或者重建面部膜和反射图,用于物理渲染,或者线性结合在基础照明下捕获的图像.
然而,他们往往与复杂的结构,如头发和详细的外表相搏.
之后的神经卷头模型[83,62,29,78,49,58,59]通过学习的卷头场捕捉精细的几何和照明效果,代价是射线缓慢行进.
最近,可点燃 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)方法[61,37,63,44,80]通过光栅化显式的Gaussian原始物加固材料特性或学习光传输,加速了渲染.
尽管取得了这些进步,但重建一个新主体仍然需要花费大量时间进行每个主体的优化,并在数据获取方面面临根本的权衡。
光相可提供受控照明,但涉及令人望而却步的硬件成本,而单光电路[72, 1, 88, 79]则在未知的照明下通过不易的反向渲染操作,经常受到烘焙的阴影残余和难以模拟现实光传输的简化分析阴影的影响。

blocks.en:
To enable instant avatar creation from a single portrait, recent feed-forward Gaussian head models [ 8 , 24 , 92 , 52 , 32 , 75 , 31 ] learn cross-identity priors for rapid 3D reconstruction and animation.
However, these methods focus solely on motion control under baked-in ambient lighting, leaving the avatars non-relightable.
Alternatively, 2D conditional diffusion models [ 41 , 27 ] directly synthesize portraits under target motion and lighting, yet struggle with precise 3D control and cross-frame identity consistency [ 21 ] .
Moreover, their multi-step denoising incurs high computational overhead, prohibiting real-time interaction.
blocks.zh:
为了能够从单一的肖像中实现即时的阿凡达创作,最近的Feed-forward Gaussian头像模型[8,24,92,52,32,75,31]为快速3D重建和动画学习跨身份前传.
然而,这些方法只注重在烘烤的环境照明下的运动控制,使得变形体无法发光.
或者,2D有条件的传播模型[41,27]在目标运动和照明下直接合成肖像,然而却与精确的3D控制和跨框架身份一致性[21]挣扎.
此外,它们的多步调试产生较高的计算间接费用,禁止实时互动。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time streaming head animation and relighting from a single image, as shown in Fig. 1 .
Our key insight is to couple an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy with a causal autoregressive neural shader that models complex light transport from 4D-consistent PBR buffers in real time.
Specifically, given a single reference image, we first reconstruct 3D Gaussians anchored on a canonical UV manifold in a feed-forward manner, augmenting each primitive with decoupled geometric and material attributes, including surface normals, base color, and roughness.
Driven by target FLAME and camera parameters, these canonical primitives are deformed and rapidly rasterized into view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers.
Such a Gaussian proxy imposes a prior on 3D consistency and temporal material coherence.
blocks.zh:
为了应付这些挑战,我们介绍了LuxAvatar,这是实时流头动画和从单一图像中重新点燃的饲料框架,如图1所示。
我们的关键洞察力是将一个可模拟的3D内在的Gaussian代用器与一个因果自旋神经阴影器对齐,该神经阴影器从4D-一致的PBR缓冲器实时模拟复杂的光传输.
具体地说,我们首先用一个单一的参考图像, 重建了3D Gaussians , 以向导的方式锚定在一条峡谷紫外线上, 用脱钩的几何和物质属性, 包括表面正常, 底色, 和粗糙度, 来补充每一个原始的。
在目标FLAME和相机参数的驱动下,这些犬形原始物变形并迅速光栅化成视线和运动相容的PBR缓冲物.
这样的高斯代用在3D一致性和时间物质一致性上具有先验性.

blocks.en:
Crucially, since the proxy already accounts for 3D geometry and viewpoint changes, our neural shader primarily addresses how to model intricate light transport efficiently and accurately.
Rather than explicitly formulating analytical PBR equations, we cast forward shading as a conditional video diffusion process that directly synthesizes complex illumination effects, such as subsurface scattering, specular highlights, and soft shadows.
However, standard video diffusion suffers from multi-step sampling overhead and bidirectional frame dependencies.
To achieve both high fidelity and efficiency, we distill a pre-trained multi-step bidirectional teacher tailored for video relighting into a two-step causal autoregressive generator with lightweight channel-wise conditioning and fast latent decoding.
Since the pre-trained teacher is designed for general relighting, we subsequently fine-tune the distilled generator on portrait relighting data to specialize it for human portraits.
blocks.zh:
关键是,由于这个代理已经说明三维几何和视角的变化,我们的神经阴影主要处理如何高效和准确地模拟复杂的光传输。
我们没有明确地制定分析的 PBR 方程,而是将阴影作为有条件的视频扩散过程, 直接合成复杂的照明效应, 如地表下散射, 光谱亮度, 和软阴影。
然而,标准的视频传播受到多步骤采样间接和双向帧依赖的影响。
为了实现高度的忠诚和效率,我们提炼出一个经过预先训练的多步双向教师,专门为视频重燃而专门设计的二步因果自递式发电机,采用轻量级的频道空调和快速潜伏解码。
由于预先训练的老师是为一般的重光设计,我们随后在肖像重光数据上微调了蒸馏发电机,专门用于人类肖像.

blocks.en:
Both training our feed-forward Gaussian proxy and fine-tuning the distilled shader require paired portrait videos under varying illumination.
To overcome the high cost of acquiring such paired data at scale, we further construct a hybrid dataset from three complementary sources:
(i) synthetic intrinsic supervision for the proxy and relit video targets for the shader, (ii) dynamic portraits under static lighting via reverse reference editing to provide real video targets with authentic facial dynamics, and (iii) static portraits under rotating illumination from public OLAT captures for physically grounded light transport.
blocks.zh:
既训练我们向前进的高斯代理 也精细调整了蒸馏遮阳器 需要在不同的光线下配对肖像录像
为了克服大规模获取这种配对数据的高成本,我们进一步从三个互补来源构建了一个混合数据集:
(一)对代理对象进行合成内在监督,对遮蔽器的视频目标进行重写,(二)通过反向参考编辑提供真实的视频目标并具有真实面部动态的静态肖像,(三)从公共OLAT捕获的旋转照明下进行静态肖像,用于实体化的光传输.

blocks.en: Our main contributions can be summarized as follows: • We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time streaming head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait, supporting explicit motion and viewpoint control alongside photorealistic light transport without per-subject optimization. • We introduce an animatable intrinsic Gaussian proxy that predicts decoupled canonical geometry and material attributes, providing view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers as explicit 4D guidance for neural shading. • We develop a two-step causal neural shader via heterogeneous distillation and curate a hybrid dataset that adapts the general relighting prior with real portrait dynamics and OLAT supervision, enabling efficient streaming with realistic facial appearance and dynamic shading.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献可归纳如下: 我们介绍LuxAvatar,这是实时流线头像动画和从单一肖像中重新点亮的向导框架,支持在不进行每个主体优化的情况下,与光现实主义光传输同时支持明显的运动和视线控制。 我们引入了一个可动性的内在高斯代词,预测脱钩的犬形几何和材料属性,提供视线和运动相容的PBR缓冲器作为神经阴影的显式4D指导. ^ 我们开发了一个双步因果神经遮荫器,通过异质的蒸馏,并整理一个混合数据集,在真实的肖像动态和OLAT监督之前,先调整一般的重光,从而能够以现实的面部外观和动态阴影来高效的流线。

blocks.en: We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time streaming head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait, supporting explicit motion and viewpoint control alongside photorealistic light transport without per-subject optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LuxAvatar,这是实时流头动画和从单一肖像中重新点亮的向导框架,支持在不进行每个主题优化的情况下,与光现实化光传输一起进行清晰的运动和视线控制。

blocks.en: We introduce an animatable intrinsic Gaussian proxy that predicts decoupled canonical geometry and material attributes, providing view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers as explicit 4D guidance for neural shading.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个动画内在的高斯代用,预测脱钩的犬形几何和材料属性,提供视线和运动相容的PBR缓冲器作为神经阴影的显式4D指导.

blocks.en: We develop a two-step causal neural shader via heterogeneous distillation and curate a hybrid dataset that adapts the general relighting prior with real portrait dynamics and OLAT supervision, enabling efficient streaming with realistic facial appearance and dynamic shading.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个双步因果神经遮荫器,通过异质的蒸馏,并整理一个混合数据集,在真实的肖像动态和OLAT监督之前,先调整一般的重光,从而能够以现实的面部外观和动态阴影来高效的流线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Feed-Forward 3D Head Avatars
blocks.zh: 2.1 Feed-Forward 3D 头神通

blocks.en:
Feed-forward head avatar methods learn cross-identity priors to reconstruct animatable heads from one or a few images without per-identity optimization.
Early radiance-field head avatars [ 39 , 40 , 9 , 85 , 13 , 14 , 71 , 70 ] represent identity and motion through deformable fields or triplanes, supporting novel-view animation at the cost of expensive ray sampling for volumetric rendering.
blocks.zh:
feed-forward head avatar 方法学习跨身份前缀,从一个或几个图像中重建一个或几个可映射头,而无需每个身份优化.
早期的光圈-场头动画[39,40,9,85,13,14,71,70]通过变形场或三叠纪来代表身份和运动,支持小说-视野动画,以昂贵的射线取样进行体积渲染.

blocks.en:
Recently, 3D Gaussian representations have mitigated this rendering bottleneck through efficient splatting, while exploring diverse animation and rendering designs.
To model facial dynamics, expression-conditioned Gaussian predictors [ 34 , 28 , 52 , 32 , 31 ] directly regress motion-dependent Gaussian attributes.
Alternatively, canonical Gaussian models [ 24 , 67 ] achieve efficient animation via FLAME-based rigging and direct RGB splatting.
Along this line, UIKA [ 75 ] constructs a Gaussian avatar from unposed images by leveraging facial correspondences and attention across screen and UV spaces for high-quality animation.
Beyond direct color splatting, GAGAvatar [ 8 ] enhances image synthesis by coupling explicit Gaussian feature splatting with a neural image decoder.
Despite their efficiency, these methods bake illumination into reconstructed appearance without explicit reflectance–illumination disentanglement, thereby precluding relighting.
blocks.zh:
最近,3D高斯的表示通过高效的镀层来缓解这种渲染瓶颈,同时探索了多种动画和渲染设计.
为了模型化面部动态,表达条件的高斯预测器[34,28,52,32,31]直接递归运动依赖的高斯属性.
或者,Canonical Gaussian模型[24,67]通过基于FLAME的装配和直接RGB电镀实现高效动画.
沿着这条线,UIKA[75]通过利用面部通信以及跨越屏幕和紫外线空间的注意力,从无位图像中构建出高斯阿凡达,用于高质量动画.
GAGAvatar[8]除了直接的彩色镀层外,通过将明显的高斯特征镀层与神经影像解码器结合,增强图像合成.
尽管这些方法效率很高,但这些方法将照明制成重建的外观,而没有明显的反射-照明散射,从而排除了再照。

blocks.en: 2.2 Relightable 3D Head Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 可燃三维头型号

blocks.en:
Methods using light stages or other calibrated capture rigs [ 2 , 78 , 83 , 62 , 61 , 63 ] build detailed relightable head models from controlled multi-view observations, but require dedicated capture and per-subject training.
To relax capture requirements, inverse-rendering approaches [ 72 , 79 , 1 , 88 ] recover geometry, reflectance, and lighting from monocular observations through subject-specific optimization.
Given only a single image, parametric face reconstruction methods [ 82 , 65 , 35 , 36 , 16 , 4 , 51 , 15 ] leverage morphable priors to infer these intrinsic properties, yet the decomposition remains ambiguous under unknown illumination.
blocks.zh:
使用光相或其他校准捕获钻机的方法[2,78,83,62,61,63]从受控多视图观测中构建了详细的可再光头模型,但需要专门的捕获和每个科目的培训.
为了放松捕捉要求,反向回转方法[72,79,1,88]通过特定主题优化,从单视观测中恢复几何,反射和照明.
由于只有一个图像,参数面重建方法[82, 65, 35, 36, 16, 4, 51, 15] 利用可变的前身推断出这些内在属性,然而在未知的照明下,分解仍然模糊不清.

blocks.en:
Beyond surface reflectance recovery, generative and feed-forward head models [ 68 , 29 , 57 , 11 , 49 , 44 , 66 , 58 , 59 ] learn cross-identity priors over volumetric or Gaussian representations to support joint view synthesis and relighting.
However, to achieve high-fidelity facial animation, existing frameworks still rely on costly test-time optimization for each new subject.
VRMM [ 84 ] fits an animatable volumetric head model to a single image via latent inversion,
URAvatar [ 37 ] adapts a universal Gaussian avatar to a phone video with joint lighting estimation,
and RelightAnyone [ 80 ] reconstructs a neutral-expression head from a single image through identity and lighting inversion.
blocks.zh:
除了表面反射恢复外,基因和饲料前导头型[68,29,57,11,49,44,66,58,59]在体积或高斯表示上学习交叉识别前导,支持联合视图合成和重燃.
然而,为了实现高真实度的面部动画,现有的框架仍然依赖于每个新题材昂贵的测试时间优化.
VRMM[84]通过潜在反演将可模拟的卷头模型与单一图像相匹配,
URAvatar [37] 将通用的高斯阿凡达改编为电话视频,并附有联合照明估计,
和Relight Anyone [80]通过身份和照明倒置从一个单一的图像中重建一个中性表达头.

blocks.en: 2.3 Generative Relighting and Rendering
blocks.zh: 2.3 基因照明和渲染

blocks.en:
Generative portrait relighting methods [ 54 , 55 , 5 , 81 , 7 ] synthesize novel illumination while preserving the observed pose and expression.
Similarly, portrait harmonization approaches [ 50 , 60 , 89 ] adapt foreground illumination to match replacement backgrounds.
Portrait video relighting methods [ 23 , 48 , 91 ] extend image relighting to dynamic facial performances using flat-lit sequences that retain the recorded motion.
They promote temporal coherence through dynamic Gaussian reconstruction and temporal blending, or by jointly denoising multiple frames with video diffusion.
More broadly, diffusion-based neural renderers [ 87 , 6 , 19 , 42 , 76 , 46 ] synthesize photorealistic RGB images or videos under target illumination, using conditions such as geometry and material buffers, depth-aware irradiance maps, and RGB references.
blocks.zh:
基因肖像重新点亮方法 [54, 55, 5, 81, 7] 合成新颖的照明,同时保留观察到的姿势和表情.
同样,肖像统一办法[50、60、89]调整前景照明,以适应替换背景。
肖像视频重燃方法[23,48,91]将图像重燃扩展至动态面部表现,使用保留录制运动的平升序列.
它们通过动态的高斯重建和时间混合,或通过视频传播联合调试多帧,促进时间一致性.
更广泛地说,基于扩散的神经成像器[87,6,19,42,76,46]在目标照明下合成了光现实化的RGB图像或视频,利用了几何学和材料缓冲器,深度感知辐射图,RGB参考.

blocks.en:
For joint control of pose, expression, and lighting, 3DMM-guided diffusion models [ 17 , 41 , 27 ] use parametric face renderings as spatial conditions for portrait synthesis.
LCVD [ 21 ] extends this paradigm to video diffusion, conditioning on reference appearance and FLAME shading sequences to synthesize relightable portrait animation over overlapping temporal windows.
However, many existing video relighting and rendering frameworks still incur substantial latency from multi-step denoising.
blocks.zh:
为了联合控制姿势,表达和照明,3DMM制导的传播模型[17,41,27]使用参数面渲染作为肖像合成的空间条件.
LCVD [21]将这一范式扩展至视频传播,在参考外观和FLAME阴影序列上设定条件,以便在重叠的时间窗口上合成可视肖像动画.
然而,许多现有的视频重新点亮和渲染框架仍然因多步骤的消音而有很大的延迟。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given a reference image I I , a sequence of driving FLAME parameters, and target camera parameters, our goal is to synthesize photorealistic, 3D-consistent portrait videos conditioned on either a target environment map for relighting or a target background for harmonization.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , LuxAvatar consists of two core components:
(1) a feed-forward intrinsic Gaussian head proxy (Sec. 3.1 ) that lifts the input portrait into an animatable 3D representation to provide view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers, and
(2) a causal autoregressive neural shader (Sec. 3.2 ) first distilled from a pre-trained bidirectional teacher for two-step streaming and relighting priors and then adapted on paired portrait data to achieve realistic facial shading and enable background harmonization.
To effectively supervise the intrinsic proxy and support paired portrait adaptation without costly dynamic light stage captures, we further detail our hybrid training dataset construction in Sec. 3.3 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Two-Step Causal Neural Shader
blocks.zh: 3.2 双阶致病神经震荡

blocks.en:
Analytical shading of the rasterized PBR buffers { 𝒞 t } \{\mathcal{C}_{t}\} is sensitive to geometry and material inaccuracies, struggling to reproduce complex light transport and fine facial details.
We therefore formulate neural shading as a real-time causal video generation process, where { 𝒞 t } \{\mathcal{C}_{t}\} provides view-aligned 3D geometry and intrinsic guidance, allowing the shader to focus on synthesizing photorealistic illumination and high-frequency appearance.
blocks.zh:
对光圈化的 PBR 缓冲器的分析阴影 { C t } \{\ mathcal{ C}_{t } 对几何学和材料不准确敏感, 难以复制复杂的光传输和细微的面部细节.
因此,我们将神经阴影化作为实时因果视频生成过程,其中{C t} {Mathcal{C}_{t}\}}提供视线对齐的3D几何和内在的引导,让阴影化者专注于合成光现实化光照和高频外观.

blocks.en:
Multi-modal conditioning. Built upon Wan2.1-1.3B [ 69 ] , our shader adopts TAEHV [ 3 ] , a compact video autoencoder with 2D convolutions and temporal memory blocks, for fast latent encoding and decoding.
It integrates multi-modal conditions according to their structural roles:
blocks.zh:
多式联运。 在Wan2.1-1.3B [69]上,我们的遮蔽器采用了TAEHV [3],一个带有2D演化和时间记忆块的紧凑视频自动编码器,用于快速潜伏编码和解码.
它根据其结构作用将多式联运条件融为一体:

blocks.en:
(1) Per-frame intrinsic and lighting cues : Each modality in the PBR buffers { 𝒞 t } \{\mathcal{C}_{t}\} is encoded and concatenated with the noisy video latents along the channel dimension to preserve spatial alignment in latent space.
For dynamic illumination control, the environment map 𝐄 t \mathbf{E}_{t} is represented by LDR, log-HDR, and direction maps, whose encoded features are injected via both channel concatenation and cross-attention.
By associating environment-map texels with fixed 3D directions and jointly conditioning on posed-space normals 𝐍 t \mathbf{N}_{t} , the shader learns how incident illumination interacts with surface orientation across motion and viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh:
(1) 纵框内在和照明提示: PBR 缓冲器 {C t } { mathcal{C}_{t } 中的每一种模式都与频道维度上的噪音视频潜伏进行编码和配合,以保持潜在空间的空间对齐.
对于动态照明控制,环境图E t \ mathbf{E}_{t}由LDR,log-HDR,和方向图代表,其编码特征通过通道凝结和交叉注意两种方式注入.
通过将环境图的texels与固定的3D方向连接起来,并在设置的空间常态Nt\mathbf{N}_{t}上进行联合调节,遮阳器学习了事件照明如何在运动和视角变化中与表面方向相互作用。

(2) Global context prefixes : The static reference I I is encoded as a token prefix to anchor subject identity and appearance details across the sequence.
For background harmonization, the target background plate B B is encoded as an additional token prefix before the reference tokens to provide scene context, while 𝐄 t \mathbf{E}_{t} is estimated from B B at inference via DiffusionLight [ 53 ] .

blocks.en:
Causal autoregressive distillation. To enable real-time streaming, we formulate the shader as a causal generator that synthesizes video chunks autoregressively in just two denoising steps per chunk, caching keys and values (KV) of the global context prefixes and past chunks.
To inherit broad relighting priors, we distill a pre-trained multi-step bidirectional teacher (Relit-LiVE [ 76 ] ) into our streamlined causal student.
Specifically, we first warm up the student on teacher ODE trajectories and then apply distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 86 ] over self-forced autoregressive student rollouts [ 25 ] .
During distillation, the teacher uses its native Wan-VAE to encode intrinsic conditions obtained from DiffusionRenderer [ 42 ] , including additional depth and metallic maps, and retains its original joint video–environment interface.
We encode the target log-HDR environment maps with Wan-VAE and perturb both the environment and student-generated video latents to the same noise level, updating the student via DMD using only the video component of the score difference between the frozen teacher and a trainable auxiliary score model.

为了继承广义的重燃前科,我们把一位经过预先训练的多步双向教师(Relit-Live [76])提炼成我们精简的因果学生.
具体来说,我们首先让学生在教师ODE轨迹上热身,然后应用分布匹配蒸馏法(DMD)[86]在自强制自动学生推出时使用[25].
在蒸馏过程中,老师使用其本土的Wan-VAE来编码从 DifusionRenderer [42] 获得的内在条件,包括额外的深度和金属图,并保留其最初的联合视频-环境接口.
我们用Wan-VAE将目标日志-HDR环境图编码,并扰动环境和学生生成的视频潜伏到相同的噪音水平,通过DMD对学生进行更新,只使用冷冻教师和可训练辅助分数模型的分数差的视频部分.

blocks.en:
Training our framework requires dynamic portrait videos paired with intrinsic buffers and varying illumination, which are prohibitively costly to capture at scale.
As illustrated in Fig. 3 , we curate three complementary data sources from in-the-wild videos and static OLAT captures to jointly supervise intrinsic decomposition, authentic facial dynamics, and physically accurate light transport.
blocks.zh:
训练我们的框架需要动态的肖像录像,配以内在的缓冲器和不同的照明,而这种影像的拍摄规模太高了。
如图3所示,我们整理了三个补充数据来源,它们来自闪烁的视频和静态的OLAT捕捉,共同监督内在分解,真实的面部动态,以及物理上准确的光传输。

blocks.en:
Intrinsic and relit video synthesis. We first leverage DiffusionRenderer [ 42 ] to generate both intrinsic labels and relit video pairs.
Its inverse renderer extracts temporally consistent base color, roughness, and normal maps from VFHQ [ 77 ] to supervise our Gaussian proxy (Sec. 3.1 ), while its forward renderer relights VFHQ clips under diverse HDR environment maps to provide paired relighting supervision for the shader.
blocks.zh:
内摄与重释视频合成. 我们首先利用扩散放电器[42]生成内在标签和重解视频对.
它的反向渲染器从VFHQ[77]中提取时间上一致的底色,粗糙度,以及正常的地图,以监督我们的高斯代用(Sec. 3.1),而它的前向渲染器则在不同的HDR环境图下重燃VFHQ剪辑,为遮荫器提供配对的重光监督.

blocks.en:
Reverse pair construction via reference editing. To prevent the shader from overfitting to synthetic artifacts in synthesized relit targets, we invert the pairing direction by keeping original VFHQ videos as real ground-truth targets while editing sampled reference frames.
For environment-map relighting, we estimate the target HDR illumination from the initial frame via DiffusionLight [ 53 ] and relight the reference frame under random HDR maps using UniRelight [ 22 ] .
For background harmonization, we employ Qwen-Image-Edit [ 74 ] to extract the clean background plate B B of the original video and composite the reference portrait onto a newly synthesized background.
blocks.zh:
通过参考编辑反向对构建. 为了防止遮蔽器在合成重写目标中过度适应合成文物,我们在编辑样本参考框时将原始的VFHQ视频作为真实的地面真实目标来反转配对方向.
关于环境图重燃,我们通过 " 传播光 " 估计初始框架的HDR照明目标,并使用 " UniRelight " 重新点燃随机的HDR地图下的参考框架。
为了统一背景,我们使用Quen-Image-Edit [74] 来提取原始视频的清洁背景盘B,并将参考肖像合成到新合成的背景.

blocks.en:
Physically grounded OLAT relighting. As in-the-wild videos mainly capture facial motion under static lighting, we further introduce continuous illumination changes using public captures from FaceOLAT [ 59 ] .
Exploiting the linearity of light transport, we continuously rotate HDR environment maps over 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} and linearly combine the OLAT basis images at each step, yielding physically accurate relit sequences under dynamic lighting.
blocks.zh:
身体受禁的OLAT重燃. 透过FaceOLAT[59]的公开捕捉,
利用光传输的线性,我们不断在360X360X360Xcirc)上旋转HDR环境图,并线性地将OLAT基础图像在每一个步骤上结合,在动态照明下产生物理精确的重排序列.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Implementation details. We train our framework in two stages.
First, the intrinsic Gaussian head proxy uses a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone with a 48 × 48 48\times 48 UV query grid to predict 192 × 192 192\times 192 canonical attribute maps.
It is trained on 512 × 512 512\times 512 images for 100K iterations using AdamW with a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} and a batch size of 64.
Second, the causal video shader is distilled via 3K ODE regression and 2K DMD steps, and then fine-tuned on our hybrid dataset for 5K iterations across 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs (batch size 32) using Muon ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} learning rate) and auxiliary AdamW updates ( 10 − 5 10^{-5} ).
Paired adaptation uses 57-frame clips for synthesized relit videos and OLAT sequences, and 81-frame clips for reverse-paired data.
At inference, we reconstruct the canonical proxy once and autoregressively generate chunks of three latent frames using two denoising steps per chunk with KV-cache reuse.
To bound the attention context during streaming, self-attention accesses the current and preceding chunks together with up to two uniformly selected chunks from earlier history.
More details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 我们分两个阶段培训我们的框架。
首先,内在的高斯头代理使用冷冻的DINov3 VIT-L/16主干网,其48×4848\时48UV查询网格来预测192×192\时192的192条犬科属性图.
它通过512×512 512\时的512图像进行训练,用于使用 AdamW 的 100K 迭代,学习率为 4× 10− 4 4\时 10\ 4} 批量大小为 64 个.
第二,通过3K ODE回归和2K DMD步骤对因果视频遮蔽器进行蒸馏,然后用Muon(10 - 4 10 - 4)和辅助AdamW(10 - 5 10 - 5)更新(10 - 5 10 - 5)对我们的混合数据集进行微调,用于跨越32个NVIDIA H20 GPU的5K迭代。
Paired的改编使用57帧剪辑用于合成的重写视频和OLAT序列,81帧剪辑用于逆向投币数据.
推论一下,我们重建了犬类代用一次, 并用KV-cache再利用每个块的两个去诺化步骤, 自动地生成三个潜在框架的块。
为了将流化过程中的注意力上下文绑定起来,自觉访问当前和之前的块,加上从以往历史中统一选定的最多两个块。
更多详情见补充材料。

blocks.en:
Datasets. Public benchmarks for head animation under dynamic illumination remain limited.
Following Sec. 3.3 , we construct training and held-out test sets from VFHQ [ 77 ] and FaceOLAT [ 59 ] for qualitative and quantitative evaluation.
To assess cross-dataset generalization, we further conduct qualitative comparisons on NeRSemble [ 33 ] , which is unseen during training.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 在动态照明下头部动画的公共基准仍然有限。
继第3.3条之后,我们从VFHQ[77]和FaceOLAT[59]建造培训和预留测试装置,用于定性和定量评估。
为了评估跨数据集的概括性,我们进一步对NERSemble[33]进行定性比较,这是在培训期间所没有的。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We primarily evaluate single-portrait head animation jointly with relighting or background harmonization.
For environment-map relighting, we compare against 2D generative models CapHuman [ 41 ] , ControlFace [ 27 ] , and LCVD [ 21 ] , and construct cascaded baselines by pairing the 3D head animator UIKA [ 75 ] with the video relighting models UniRelight [ 22 ] or Relit-LiVE [ 76 ] .
For background harmonization, we similarly pair the 2D animator Follow-Your-Emoji (FYE) [ 47 ] or UIKA with the video harmonization models RelightVid [ 18 ] or UniLumos [ 43 ] .
We omit comparisons with RelightAnyone [ 80 ] and URAvatar [ 37 ] due to the lack of public implementations.
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们主要评价单像头动画与重燃或背景协调。
对于环境图重燃,我们比较2D基因模型Cap Human [41],ControlFace [27],和LCVD [21],通过将3D头动画机UIKA [75] 与视频重燃模型UniRelight [22] 或Relit-Live [76] 配对来构建级联基线.
为了实现背景协调,我们同样将2D动画机Follow-Your-Emoji(FYE)[47]或UIKA与视频协调模型RelightVid[18]或UniLumos[43]配对。
我们省略了与Relight Anyone [80] 和URAvatar [37] 的比较,因为缺乏公开执行.

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. We measure foreground reconstruction quality via PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, identity preservation via ArcFace [ 12 ] cosine similarity (CSIM), and motion accuracy via average expression and pose distances (AED/APD).
CSIM is averaged over frames with valid face detections across all methods.
We benchmark inference throughput in FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 D GPU.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度。 我们通过PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS测量前景重建质量,通过ArcFace [12] 余弦相似度(CSIM)测量身份保存质量,并通过平均表达和构成距离(AED/APD)测量运动精度。
CSIM在帧面上平均使用各种方法的有效面部检测.
我们把FPS在单一的NVIDIA RTX 5090 D GPU上的推论量作为基准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparisons with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Background harmonization comparison. We show cross-reenactment results on (a) VFHQ and (b) NeRSemble, with reference images and target backgrounds shown at the top.
The last column displays the driving frames.
blocks.zh:
图5:背景统一比较。 我们在(a) VFHQ和(b) NERSemble上显示交叉重现结果,并在顶端显示参考图像和目标背景。
最后一栏显示驱动框.

blocks.en:
Environment-map relighting. As shown in Fig. 4 , CapHuman, ControlFace and LCVD struggle with identity preservation and lighting control.
UIKA-based cascades inherit upstream deformation artifacts, as downstream video relighters are trained to preserve input structure.
Moreover, their general-scene priors often yield less convincing facial shading.
In contrast, our full pipeline achieves more faithful lighting responses with superior identity preservation and reconstruction quality, consistent with the metrics in Table 1 .
The supplementary material provides additional qualitative results for the above comparisons, as well as evaluations of direct relighting methods (3DPR [ 59 ] , Lite2Relight [ 58 ] , DiffusionRenderer [ 42 ] , Relit-LiVE, and UniRelight) using target-pose RGB frames as input.
blocks.zh:
环境图重燃. 如图4所示,CapHuman,ControlFace和LCVD在身份保护和照明控制上挣扎.
以UIKA为基础的级联继承上游变形文物,因为下游的视频重光器被训练来保存输入结构.
此外,其一般场面前科往往产生不太令人信服的面部阴影。
相比之下,我们整个管道实现了更忠实的照明反应,其特性保存和重建质量更高,符合表1中的衡量标准。
补充材料为上述比较提供了额外的定性结果,以及对直接重燃方法的评价(3DPR [59],Lite2Relight [58],扩散渲染器 [42],Relit-LiVe,和UniRelight) 使用目标持有RGB框架作为输入.

blocks.en:
Background harmonization. Figure 5 compares harmonization results on backgrounds synthesized by GPT Image 2.
Under challenging illumination, both 2D and 3D cascades paired with RelightVid or UniLumos exhibit appearance distortions or unnatural shading.
By sharing a common relighting prior across environment-map relighting and background harmonization, our method produces more realistic facial appearance and natural lighting effects, with quantitative results reported in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
统一背景。 图5比较了GPT图像2合成的背景的调和结果.
在具有挑战性的照明下,与RelightVid或UniLumos配对的2D级和3D级级联都显示出外观扭曲或不自然的阴影。
通过共享一个共同的重新点亮前跨环境图重新点亮和背景协调,我们的方法产生了更现实的面部外观和自然照明效应,补充材料中报告了定量结果。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, our method runs substantially faster than baselines, achieving 20.31 FPS on a single GPU and 26.02 FPS on two GPUs with inference optimization.
Finally, since predicted target illumination on VFHQ may deviate from the true lighting, quantitative metrics alone cannot fully reflect perceptual quality.
We thus provide a user study in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们的方法运行大大快于基线,在单一的GPU上达到20.31 FPS,在两个GPU上达到26.02 FPS,并进行推论优化.
最后,由于VFHQ上的预测目标照明可能偏离真正的照明,光是量化的度量标准无法充分反映知觉质量.
因此,我们在补充材料中提供了用户研究。

blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.zh: 表2:培训战略和内在代用安排。

blocks.en: Effect of training strategy and intrinsic proxy. Table 2 ablates our training strategy and intrinsic proxy on the VFHQ and FaceOLAT test sets.
blocks.zh: 培训战略和内在代理的效果。 表2 放弃了我们的训练策略和VFHQ和FaceOLAT测试集的内在代名词.

blocks.en:
Training strategy. We compare our full training pipeline against two variants: (1) DMD-only, which evaluates the causal shader after 2K distillation steps without paired portrait adaptation, and (2) Direct SF, which fine-tunes a generic Self-Forcing initialization on our paired data, bypassing relighting distillation.
Our full model consistently outperforms both variants across all metrics, confirming that distilling relighting priors and adapting to paired portrait data are both essential and complementary.
blocks.zh:
培训战略。 我们把我们的全训练管道比作两个变体:(1)只使用DMD,在2K蒸馏步骤后评价因果荫影,而不进行配对肖像改造;(2)直接SF,微调我们配对数据上通用的自强制初始化,绕过重燃蒸馏.
我们的完整模型始终超越所有指标的两种变体,确认提炼前身和适应配对肖像数据既至关重要,又相辅相成。

blocks.en:
Intrinsic proxy. We replace our full PBR buffers { 𝒞 t } \{\mathcal{C}_{t}\} with three alternatives while keeping all other conditions unchanged: (1) GS-RGB, which renders standard RGB Gaussians with baked-in source lighting; (2) GS-N, which provides only our Gaussian normal maps { 𝐍 t } \{\mathbf{N}_{t}\} ; and (3) FLAME-N, which rasterizes coarse FLAME mesh normals.
GS-N and FLAME-N show mixed results on FaceOLAT, whose static portraits do not fully reflect the benefits of animated normals.
These benefits are more evident on VFHQ, where GS-N outperforms FLAME-N across all metrics.
Conditioning on the full PBR buffers consistently achieves the best results across all datasets, demonstrating the necessity of shading-free material cues { 𝐀 t , 𝐑 t } \{\mathbf{A}_{t},\mathbf{R}_{t}\} and fine-grained geometry { 𝐍 t } \{\mathbf{N}_{t}\} .
blocks.zh:
内脉代用. 我们用三种替代方法取代完整的 PBR 缓冲器 { C t } { mathcal{ C}_{t } , 同时保持所有其它条件不变:(1) GS- RGB, 使标准 RGB Gaussians 具有烤入源照明; (2) GS- N, 仅提供我们的 Gaussian 普通地图 { Nt } { mathbf{ N}_{t } ; (3) FLAME-N, 使粗的 FLAME 网格正常。
GS-N和FLAME-N在FaceOLAT上显示的结果褒贬不一,其静态肖像不能充分反映动画正常的优点.
这些好处在联邦卫生总部更为明显,该总部的GS-N在所有衡量标准上都超过了FLAME-N。
在完整的 PBR 缓冲器上的条件一致地实现所有数据集中的最佳结果,表明有必要进行无阴影的材料提示 {A t, R t } {Mathbf{A}_{t},\mathbf{R}_{t}\}}和精细的几何 {Ntt} {Mathbf{N}_{t}\}}。

blocks.zh: 图6:因果神经阴影效应. 在看不见的NERSemble数据集上,我们的遮光器合成了依赖表达的皱纹,并减少了眼镜扭曲.

blocks.en:
Effect of the causal neural shader. On the unseen NeRSemble dataset (Fig. 6 ), the LBS-driven Gaussian proxy fails to produce expression-dependent forehead wrinkles missing from the reference image and introduces non-rigid bending along the eyeglass rims.
Our neural shader leverages learned video priors to synthesize realistic dynamic wrinkles and preserve the structural rigidity of the glasses under novel illumination, generalizing effectively to unseen domains without per-subject optimization.
blocks.zh:
因果神经阴影效应. 在看不见的 NERSemble 数据集(图6)上,LBS驱动的高斯代理无法产生参考图像中缺失的依赖表达的额头皱纹,并引入了沿眼镜边缘的非刚性弯曲.
我们的神经遮蔽器利用学习到的视频前传来合成现实的动态皱纹,在新光照下保持眼镜的结构刚性,在不进行每个主体优化的情况下有效地将镜片归纳到看不见的领域.

blocks.en:
Effect of hybrid training data. Fig. 7 demonstrates the complementary roles of our three training data sources.
While synthesized relit videos from DiffusionRenderer provide diverse illumination supervision, removing reverse pairs visibly degrades mouth and tooth details, as real video targets are crucial for preserving high-frequency appearance and faithful motion adherence.
Furthermore, incorporating static OLAT captures under rotating illumination provides physically grounded supervision for continuous lighting transitions, significantly improving dynamic shading fidelity on moving heads without requiring costly dynamic light stage captures.
blocks.zh:
混合培训数据的效果。 图7显示了我们三个培训数据来源的互补作用。
虽然从DifupulationRenderer合成的重读视频提供了多样的照明监督,但去除反向对可明显降低口腔和牙齿细节,因为真实的视频目标对于保持高频外观和忠实的运动坚持性至关重要.
此外,在旋转照明下将静态OLAT捕获法纳入,为连续的照明过渡提供了实实在在的监督,大大提高了移动头部的动态遮蔽忠诚度,而不需要昂贵的动态光相捕获法。

blocks.en:
Long-sequence stability. To assess error accumulation during streaming, we evaluate five VFHQ test sequences of 982–984 frames at rollout lengths of 81, 333, and the full sequence.
Shorter rollouts periodically reset the inference state between segments, whereas the full rollout streams continuously without resetting the KV cache.
Table 3 shows minimal foreground degradation, with an average PSNR drop of only 0.27 dB from 81-frame to full rollouts, while the background drift largely stems from inherent camera jitter in the ground-truth VFHQ videos.
blocks.zh:
长序稳定. 为了评估流化过程中的误差积累,我们评价了五个VFHQ测试序列982–984帧,展开长度81,333,以及全序列.
更短的推出会定期重置段间的推论状态,而全推出流则会持续不重置 KV 缓存.
表3显示前景退化程度最低,平均PSNR下降只有0.27分贝,从81帧降至全面推出,而背景漂移主要源于地面实况VFHQ视频中固有的相机颤抖。

blocks.en:
Runtime ablation. Table 4 (a) evaluates our standalone shader over 57 frames, excluding Gaussian reconstruction and rasterization.
Our two-step shader takes only 4.19 s versus 556.51 s for the 50-step Relit-LiVE ( 132.82 × 132.82\times speedup), while outperforming two-step variants with Wan-VAE and token concatenation by up to 18.60 × 18.60\times .
Inference optimization, detailed in the supplementary material, further cuts runtime to 2.42 s at 23.55 FPS.
Table 4 (b) evaluates the end-to-end dual-GPU pipeline over 984 frames, where GPU 1 performs two-step denoising while GPU 2 concurrently executes Gaussian reconstruction, rasterization, condition encoding, and latent decoding, achieving 26.02 FPS.
blocks.zh:
运行时间衰竭。 表4 (a) 评估我们的独立遮阳器在57帧以上,不包括高斯重建和光栅化。
我们的双步遮阳器对50步雷利特-LiVE(132.82×132.82\时速)只需4.19s对556.51s,而与Wan-VAE的双步遮阳器和令牌协和则最多可达18.60×18.60\时速。
在补充材料中详述的推论优化,进一步缩短运行时间到23.55 FPS的2.42s.
表4(b)评价端对端双GPU输油管超过984帧,其中GPU 1执行两步调试,而GPU 2同时执行高斯重建,光栅化,条件编码,以及潜在解码,实现26.02 FPS.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait.
By coupling an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy with a causal neural shader, our approach leverages view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers as 4D guidance to synthesize fine-scale appearance and complex light transport beyond coarse 3D representations.
Heterogeneous distillation further enables low-latency autoregressive streaming, while our hybrid training strategy adapts general relighting priors to authentic facial dynamics and physically grounded lighting changes.
Extensive experiments demonstrate temporally coherent, real-time head animation, relighting, and background harmonization, without requiring per-subject optimization or dynamic light stage captures.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍LuxAvatar, 即时头像动画和从一幅肖像中重新点亮的图像。
通过将一个可模拟的3D内在的高斯代用器与因果神经遮蔽器结合,我们的方法利用了视图和运动相容的PBR缓冲器作为4D指导,以合成精细的外观和复杂的光传输,超越粗糙的3D表示.
异质蒸馏进一步使低纬度自动回流成为可能,而我们的混合训练策略则根据真实的面部动力学和体基照明变化来调整一般的重燃前缀.
广泛的实验演示了时间性连贯,实时的头部动画,重燃,和背景协调,而不需要每个主体优化或动态光级捕捉.

blocks.en: A.1 Intrinsic Gaussian Head Proxy
blocks.zh: A.1 内向高斯头代理

blocks.en:
Architecture and attribute parameterization. In our canonical proxy, image-space and UV-space DINOv3 ViT-L/16 [ 64 ] token streams are fused by a 4-layer transformer ( 1024 1024 -dim tokens) using 48 × 48 48\times 48 learnable UV queries, and upsampled by the DPT-style decoder [ 56 ] into a 192 × 192 × 128 192\times 192\times 128 canonical feature map 𝐅 \mathbf{F} .
Gaussians are instantiated exclusively at texels within the valid FLAME UV mask [ 38 ] , with base color 𝐚 i \mathbf{a}_{i} and roughness r i r_{i} bounded to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] via sigmoid activations and canonical normals 𝐧 i \mathbf{n}_{i} normalized to unit length.
blocks.zh:
架构和属性参数化. 在我们的犬形代理中,图像空间和紫外空间 DINOv3 VIT-L/16 [64] 符号流由4层变压器(1024 1024 - dim orders)连接,使用48×48\ times 48可学习的紫外线查询,由DPT风格的解码器[56]做成192×192×128 192\tims 192\tims 128 犬形特征图 F\mathbf{F}.
在有效的 FLAME UV 掩码 [38] 内,高斯人完全在Texels 上被即时化,基色为 i\ mathbf{a}_{i} 和粗糙 r r_{i} 通过 sigmoid 激活和 犬类正常 i\ mathb{n}_{i} 规范化为单位长度 。

blocks.en:

A.2 Causal Neural Shader

blocks.en:
Latent grid and multi-modal conditioning. The frozen TAEHV autoencoder [ 3 ] applies 8 × 8\times spatial downsampling and 4 × 4\times temporal compression into a 16-channel latent space (mapping 57- and 81-frame RGB clips to 15 and 21 latent frames), which our Wan2.1-1.3B [ 69 ] backbone generates autoregressively in 3-frame latent chunks.
In the channel-concatenation branch, the three PBR buffers and three illumination maps (LDR, log-HDR, and 3D direction maps) are independently encoded at the input video scale into six spatially aligned 16-channel latents and concatenated with the 16-channel noisy video latent, forming a 112-channel patch-embedding input without increasing the video token count.
In the parallel environment cross-attention branch, the three lighting maps are spatially downsampled before 8 × 8\times autoencoder compression and 2 × 2\times strided projection into compact lighting context tokens concatenated with a fixed empty-prompt embedding from the frozen text encoder.
Reference and background latents are separately projected into spatial token grids with the same feature dimension as video tokens, increasing sequence length without changing the 112-channel video input.
With a background prefix, BG and reference occupy the first two temporal positions, and video RoPE indices and KV-cache offsets are shifted accordingly.
Chunk-causal attention allows video tokens to access both prefixes and available video history, while excluding future chunks.
blocks.zh:
低位网格和多模式配置。 冷冻的TAEHV自动编码器[3]应用了8×8\时的空间下采样,4×4\时的时空压缩成16通道的潜在空间(将57和81帧的RGB剪辑映射到15和21帧),我们的Wan2.1-1.3B[69]骨干在3帧潜在块中自动生成.
在频道连接分支中,三幅PBR缓冲图和三幅照明图(LDR,log-HDR,和3D方向图)在输入视频尺度上被独立编码为六幅空间对齐的16频道潜伏图,并与16频道的喧闹视频潜伏图相配合,形成112频道的补丁嵌入图,而不增加视频符号计数.
在平行环境的交叉注意分支中,在8×8\时自动编码器压缩和2×2\时的斜拉线投影之前,三张照明图在空间上下取样成紧凑的照明上下文符号,由冷冻文本编码器嵌入固定的空速率.

由于背景前缀,BG和参考资料占据了前两个时间位置,视频RoPE指数和KV-cache抵消也相应转移.

blocks.en:
Data composition. For paired portrait adaptation, we use 1,000 synthesized relit video records, 40,355 reverse-constructed environment-map relighting pairs, 41,777 reverse-constructed background harmonization pairs, and 55,840 OLAT relit sequences.
These pools are sampled with weights of 5 % 5\% , 45 % 45\% , 20 % 20\% , and 30 % 30\% , respectively.
Synthesized relit and OLAT clips contain 57 frames, while reverse-constructed clips contain 81 frames.
blocks.zh:
数据组成. 对于配对的肖像改编,我们使用1000个合成的重排视频记录,40,355个反向构造的环境图重排对,41,777个反向构造的背景协调对,55,840个OLAT重排序列.
这些游泳池的样本重量分别为5%、45%、20%、30%、30%。
合成重排和OLAT剪辑包含57帧,而反向构造剪辑包含81帧.

blocks.en:
Data use across training stages. The intrinsic Gaussian proxy is trained on 46,795 VFHQ clip groups using original RGB frames and DiffusionRenderer intrinsic pseudo-labels.
ODE warm-up and DMD use VFHQ clips with sampled HDR environment maps.
The student receives proxy-rendered PBR buffers, while the teacher and auxiliary score model use DiffusionRenderer intrinsics.
ODE warm-up learns from teacher-generated trajectories, whereas DMD transfers the teacher’s relighting prior without paired relit RGB targets.
For paired adaptation, the student continues to use proxy-rendered PBR buffers and is supervised by synthesized relit videos, original videos from reverse-constructed pairs, and OLAT relit sequences.
blocks.zh:
在整个培训阶段使用数据。 内在的Gaussian代理在46,795 VFHQ剪辑组上接受训练,使用原始的RGB帧和DifmusionRender 内在的伪标签.
ODE热身和DMD使用VFHQ剪辑带样本的HDR环境图.
学生接收代理的PBR缓冲器,而教师和辅助分数模型则使用DiffusionRenderer内在.
ODE 热身从老师生成的轨迹中学习,而DMD则转移老师的重点前,而不对齐重写RGB目标.
对于配对改造,学生继续使用代理式的PBR缓冲器,并且通过合成的重写视频,反向构型对的原始视频,以及OLAT重写序列来监督.

blocks.en:
Teacher selection. Relit-LiVE generally produces softer, more natural facial lighting.
DiffusionRenderer is more prone to producing an overly specular, metallic appearance on faces.
We therefore use Relit-LiVE as the distillation teacher to transfer its broad relighting prior to our shader.
However, Relit-LiVE may miss subtle expression changes, so we use DiffusionRenderer to synthesize paired relit targets that better preserve the source video’s facial motion.
We visually inspect the synthesized relit videos before including them in the training set.
blocks.zh:
师选. Relit-LiVE一般产生更柔软,更自然的面部照明.
散射器更容易在脸上产生过于光谱的金属外观.
因此,我们用Relit-LiVE作为蒸馏的老师,在我们的遮阳器之前转移它的宽光.
然而,Relit-LiVE可能错过了微妙的表达变化,因此我们使用DifmusionRender来合成配对的重写目标,以更好地保存源视频的面部运动.
我们通过视觉检查 合成的重读视频,然后把它们 纳入培训集。

blocks.en:
Reference editing for reverse pairs. The edited reference should replace the original illumination, including its cast shadows, while the original video remains the real target.
In our experience, UniRelight [ 22 ] achieves more pronounced and realistic lighting changes than Qwen-Image-Edit [ 74 ] , reducing residual source shading that would weaken relighting supervision.
We therefore use UniRelight for environment-map reference editing.
For background pairs, we favor Qwen-Image-Edit for its clean background extraction and coherent joint editing of backgrounds and portrait lighting.
Since these edits can alter identity, we use ArcFace [ 12 ] cosine similarity to flag potential identity changes, followed by visual review to exclude failed edits.
blocks.zh:
反对的参考编辑. 编辑后的参考文献应当替换原光,包括其投影,而原视频仍然是真实目标.
根据我们的经验,UniRelight [22] 实现比Quen-Image-Edit [74] 更显著,更现实的照明变化,减少剩余源阴影,从而削弱重燃监管.
因此,我们使用UniRelight进行环境图参考编辑。
对于背景配对,我们赞成Quen-Image-Edit的清洁背景提取和连贯地联合编辑背景和肖像照明.
由于这些编辑可以改变身份,因此我们使用ArcFace [12] 的余弦相似度与旗下潜在身份变化,然后进行视觉审查以排除失败的编辑.

After the two denoising steps, we run a clean-latent forward pass to cache the completed chunk’s keys and values for subsequent chunks, following Self-Forcing [ 25 ] .

blocks.en:
Condition caching and kernel fusion. We compute reference, optional background, and empty-prompt text projections once per stream and cache them across chunks.
For each chunk, we compute lighting projections and joint text–lighting cross-attention K/V once, sharing them across the two denoising steps and the clean-latent KV update.
We also fuse QKV projections, RoPE, AdaLN modulation, and gated residual updates using torch.compile and custom CUDA kernels.

有条件的缓冲和内核聚变. 我们计算引用,可选的背景, 和空即时文本投影一次 并缓存到块。
对每个块,我们计算照明预测和联合文本,一次点亮交叉注意的 K/V,在两个调试步骤和干净的相对 KV更新中分享。
我们还将QKV预测、ROPE、AdaLN调制以及用火炬加门的剩余更新装入引信。 编译和自定义 CUDA 内核.

blocks.en:
Exact tiered KV management. Historical chunks may be selected again by Eq. ( S6 ), so their KV states must remain available until their last use.
Since this selection depends only on chunk indices, we can determine cache lifetimes without accessing future frames.
For short clips of known length, we precompute the access schedule and recycle GPU slots after each chunk’s last use.
For long streams, inactive KV blocks are offloaded to CPU memory and reloaded on demand, keeping GPU memory bounded.
Under our selection rule, chunk i i can be discarded once generation advances beyond chunk 4 ​ i + 1 4i+1 , independently of the final sequence length.
These storage operations preserve the BF16 cache values and the selected attention context.
blocks.zh:
精确分级KV管理. 历史块可能再次被 Eq. (S6 ) 选中, 因此它们的 KV 状态必须保留到最后使用为止 。
由于此选择仅依赖于块索引,我们可以在不访问未来帧的情况下确定缓存寿命.
对于已知长度的短片段,我们先计算访问时间表,并在每个块最后使用后循环GPU插槽.
对于长流,不活跃的KV块会被卸载到CPU内存,并按要求重新加载,保持GPU内存的界限.
根据我们的选择规则, 块i可以被丢弃 一旦生成推进 超过块 4 i + 1 4i+1, 独立于最终序列长度。
这些存储操作保留了BF16缓存值和选定的注意上下文.

blocks.en: C Additional Evaluation
blocks.zh: C 其他评价

blocks.en: C.1 Environment-Map Relighting
blocks.zh: C.1 环境图参考

blocks.en:
Figure S1 presents additional qualitative comparisons with the joint animation-and-relighting baselines from the main paper.
Across varied identities and target illumination, our method better preserves facial appearance and produces more plausible directional shading while following the driving expressions.
blocks.zh:
图S1提供了与主要论文中联合动画和照明基线的额外质量比较。
通过各种身份和瞄准照明,我们的方法更好地保存面部外观,并在跟踪驱动表达时产生更可信的方向阴影。

blocks.en: Table S4 : User study mean ranks over 21 questionnaires. Lower is better, best results are in bold.
blocks.zh: 表S4:用户研究在21份调查问卷中名列前茅。 下调更好,最佳结果用粗体表示。

blocks.en: C.2 Direct Environment-Map Relighting
blocks.zh: C.2 直接环境图示

blocks.en:
Table S2 compares LuxAvatar with five direct relighting baselines: 3DPR [ 59 ] , Lite2Relight [ 58 ] , DiffusionRenderer [ 42 ] , Relit-LiVE [ 76 ] , and UniRelight [ 22 ] .
These baselines receive target-pose RGB frames as input.
For DiffusionRenderer and Relit-LiVE, we first use DiffusionRenderer’s inverse rendering model to extract intrinsic buffers from these frames for subsequent relighting.
LuxAvatar instead synthesizes both target head motion and novel illumination from a single reference portrait.
Figure S3 provides qualitative comparisons.
blocks.zh:
表S2比较了LuxAvatar的五个直接重燃基线:3DPR [59],Lite2Relight [58],散射器 [42],Relit-Live [76],和UniRelight [22].
这些基线作为投入接收目标持有RGB框架。
对于DifupulationRender和Relit-LiVE,我们首先使用DifupulationRender的反向渲染模型从这些帧中提取内在的缓冲,以进行后续的重燃.
LuxAvatar转而从单一的参考肖像中合成目标头运动和小说照明.
图S3提供了质量比较。

blocks.en:
Despite the baselines’ access to target-pose RGB frames, LuxAvatar performs best in PSNR, LPIPS, CSIM, and AED on both benchmarks.
With inference optimization, LuxAvatar achieves approximately 6 6 – 360 × 360\times the FPS of these baselines.
In particular, paired portrait adaptation substantially improves facial shading fidelity and color accuracy over general-scene video relighting methods, especially on physically captured FaceOLAT sequences.
blocks.zh:
尽管基线可以访问目标拥有的 RGB 框架, LuxAvatar 在PSNR、LPIPS、CSIM和AED两个基准上都表现最好。
随着推论的优化,LuxAvatar实现了大约6 6 — 360×360\的这些基线的FPS.
特别是,配对的肖像改造大大改进了面部遮蔽忠诚度和彩色精度,优于一般场景视频重燃方法,特别是在实际捕获的FaceOLAT序列上。

blocks.en: C.3 Background Harmonization
blocks.zh: C.3 背景协调

blocks.en:
In our harmonization comparison against two-stage cascades (Follow-Your-Emoji (FYE) [ 47 ] or UIKA [ 75 ] followed by RelightVid [ 18 ] or UniLumos [ 43 ] ), the driven video from each animation method is shared across both downstream harmonization methods under identical source, motion, and background inputs.
We evaluate on VFHQ test clips, following the evaluation protocol detailed in the main paper.
As shown in Table S3 , LuxAvatar outperforms all four cascades across reconstruction, identity, and motion metrics.
Figure S2 provides additional qualitative comparisons across diverse target backgrounds.
blocks.zh:
在我们与两阶段级联(Fafter-Your-Emoji(FYE)[47]或UIKA[75],然后是RelightVid[18]或UniLumos[43])的协调统一比较中,每种动画方法的驱动视频在相同的源头、运动和背景投入下在下游统一方法之间共享。
我们根据主要文件详述的评价协议,对VFHQ测试片段进行评价。
如表S3所示,LuxAvatar在重建、身份和运动度量度方面超越了所有四套级联。
图S2提供了不同目标背景的额外质量比较。

blocks.en: Figure S5 : Long-sequence cross-reenactment under two lighting conditions. The top row shows the driving frames, while the middle and bottom rows show our results under the estimated driving-scene illumination and the Pylons environment map.
blocks.zh: 图S5:两个照明条件下的长序交叉重现. 上行显示驱动帧,而中下行显示我们在估计的驱动-场景照明和Pylons环境图下的结果.

blocks.en: C.4 Training Strategy and Intrinsic Proxy
blocks.zh: C.4 培训战略和内幕代理

blocks.en:
Figure S4 complements the quantitative ablations in the main paper.
DMD-only loses fine facial details, while Direct SF and the normal-only variants show discrepancies in eye appearance and shadows around the nose.
Our full model better preserves these details under target lighting.
blocks.zh:
图S4补充了主要文件中的定量数字。
DMD-只损失了细微的面部细节,而Direct SF和普通的仅限变体则显示眼睛外观和鼻子周围阴影的差异.
我们的完整模型最好把这些细节保存在目标照明下.

blocks.en: C.5 Long-Sequence Stability
blocks.zh: C.5 长序稳定

blocks.en:
Figure S5 shows cross-reenactment over continuous 984-frame rollouts.
We animate the same reference identity using another subject’s FLAME motion and camera parameters under two fixed environment maps, generating each sequence without resetting the KV cache.
The displayed frames retain consistent identity and distinct lighting while following changes in the driving expression.
blocks.zh:
图S5显示连续的984框架推出之后的交叉更新。
我们在两个固定环境图下使用另一个对象的FLAME运动参数和相机参数将相同的参考身份激活,生成每个序列而不重置KV缓存.
显示的帧在跟踪驱动表达式的变化的同时,保留了一致的特性和独特的照明.

blocks.en: C.6 User Study
blocks.zh: C.6 用户研究

blocks.en:
We evaluate 20 video cases: 10 for environment-map relighting with six methods and 10 for background harmonization with five methods.
The interface displays synchronized, looping videos alongside the reference portrait, driving video, and target illumination or background.
Case order and anonymous method labels are randomized for each session.
For each case, respondents rank all methods from best to worst, without ties, on overall visual quality, lighting or background consistency, and identity preservation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了20个视频案例:10个用于重新点亮环境图,采用6种方法,10个用于与5种方法统一背景。
界面显示同步,与参考肖像同时循环视频,驱动视频,以及目标照明或背景.
每个会话都随机排列案件顺序和匿名方法标签.
对于每个案例,受访者根据整体视觉质量、照明或背景一致性以及身份保护情况,将所有方法从最佳到最坏,没有关联。

blocks.en:
Table S4 summarizes mean ranks over 21 completed questionnaires, with the two tasks evaluated separately.
LuxAvatar achieves the lowest mean rank for overall visual quality, lighting or background consistency, and identity preservation in both tasks.
blocks.zh:
表S4汇总了21份填写调查表的平均排名,对两项任务分别进行了评估。
LuxAvatar在整体视觉质量,照明或背景一致性,以及身份保护两个任务中都取得了最低的中位数.

blocks.en: D Limitations
blocks.zh: D. 限制

blocks.en:
Two aspects of LuxAvatar remain to be addressed in future work.
The FLAME-driven proxy lacks an explicit tongue model, so tongue motions such as protrusion cannot be directly controlled.
In addition, our training data lack multi-view coverage of the entire head, leaving the geometry and appearance of the back of the head underconstrained and limiting reliable synthesis of rear views.
blocks.zh:
在今后的工作中,卢克萨瓦塔尔的两个方面仍有待解决。
FLAME驱动的代理缺乏明确的舌头模型,因此无法直接控制伸缩等舌头运动.
此外,我们的训练数据缺乏对整个头部的多视图覆盖,使得头部后部的几何和外观受到不足的限制,限制了后部视图的可靠合成.
